skillSpector.unavailableDetails: The published assessment could not be loaded. This listing’s check status is unknown.
skillSpector.absent: No published assessment matches this listing.
skillSpector.disclaimer: This historical report covers only the listed Skill files at the recorded revision. It does not run code or guarantee safety.
skillSpector.unverified: The current revision of this listing has not been verified.
skillSpector.incomplete: The static check did not cover all content. Review the findings and coverage limits below.
skillSpector.empty: No findings were reported by the completed static checks.
skillSpector.selected: Only a selection of catalog sources is checked.
skillSpector.older: This report is older than seven days or describes a different revision. It does not establish the current state.
skillSpector.staticParseLimit: Some expressions exceeded the static parser’s limits.
skillSpector.referenceMissing: Some local file references were not found in the scanned Skill files; they may be created at runtime.
skillSpector.analyzerIncomplete: An analyzer did not complete all planned checks.
skillSpector.pendingCoverage: {checked} of {total} selected skills checked. Remaining skills are waiting for a background check.
